title: DuckStation 0.1-10693: official stable release
summary: DuckStation published 0.1-10693 on January 24, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation emulator project.

blocks.text: The DuckStation project published version 0.1-10693 on January 24, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: e41ca3245 AudioStream: Fix changing stretch mode without buffer change. a7d29da8e System: Clamp typical time to frame period on MacOS. abed81d53 GPUDevice: Use present instead of current time for skip logic. 71f46cf8c GPUThread: Update core thread window size on core thread.
